chapter.verse: Khatvei Zeisu in, “Note lungmang kei un; Pasian um un la, kei zong hong um un.
Ka Pa’ inn sungah omna tampi a om hi. A om kei leh, no kiangah kong gen zo ding hi. Note om nading mun bawlkhol dingin ka pai ding hi.
Pai-in na om nading uh ka bawl leh, no kiangah kong paikik ding a; ka omna munah na om nadingun ka hong la ding hi.
Ka pai nading mun lampi na thei uh hi,” a cih leh,
Thomas in, “Topa aw, na pai nading thei lo ka hih uh ciangin, lampi bangci theih ding ka hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Keimah in lampi ka hi hi, thuman thutak ka hi hi, nuntakna lah ka hi hi. Kei hong suang loin kuamah in Pa kiang a tung zo kei ding hi.
Note in kei nong theih uh leh, ka Pa zong na thei ding uh hi, tu-a kipanin ka Pa na mu zo uh hi,” a ci hi.
Filip in, “Topa aw, Pa hong lak lecin ka deihna uh a kicing ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Filip aw, kei in note tawh hih tanvei ka omkhawm hangin hong thei lo na hi hiam? Kei hong mu mi in Pa zong a mu zo hi. ‘Pa hong lak in,’ bang hangin na ci hiam?
Pa sungah ka om a, kei sungah Pa a om cih um lo na hi hiam? Note kiangah kong gen thu in keima thu hong hilh ka hi kei hi. Kei sunga teeng ka Pa in na hong sem ahi hi.
Pa sungah ka om a, Pa in kei sungah a om thu hong um in. Ahih kei leh zong ka bawl nalamdangte’ thu ngaihsunin hong um un.”
“Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, kei hong um mi in ka bawl bang nate bawlin tua sangin a lianzaw a bawl ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pa kiangah ka ciah ding hi.
Note in keima min suangin thu na nget khempeuh uh Ta tungah Pa’ minthan’na a kilat nadingin ka hih ding hi.
Kei min suangin na nget peuhmah uh kong hih ding hi.”
“Kei nong it uh leh, ka thupiakna na mang ding uh hi.
Keimah in Pa kiangah thu ka ngen ding a, note tawh a omkhawm tawntung dingin Kha Siangtho ahi adang Huhpa hong pia ding hi.
Tua Kha Siangtho leitung mite in mu loin thei lo uh ahih ciangin a sang zo kei uh hi. Tua Kha Siangtho in note tawh omkhawmin, note sungah om ding ahih ciangin amah na thei ding uh hi.”
“Keimah in note tagahte bangin kong nusia kei ding a, note kiangah kong pai lai ding hi.
Tawlkhat khit ciangin leitung mite in kei hong mu lo ding uh hi. No na hih uh leh, nong mu ding uh hi. Keimah nungta ka hih ciangin, note zong na nungta ding uh hi.
Pa sungah kei om a, kei sungah note na om uh leh, note sungah kei ka om tua ni ciangin na thei ding uh hi.
Ka thupiakna nei a, a zui mi in kei hong it hi. Kei hong it mi ka Pa in a it ding hi. Keimah in zong amah ka it ding a, ama kiangah ka kilang ding hi,” a ci hi.
Judas Iskariot hi lo adang Judas in, “Topa ko kiangah na kilat hangin, leitung mite kiangah bang hang kilang lo ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Kei hong it mi in ka thu zui ding a, ka Pa in amah a it ding a, ama kiangah hawhin, amah tawh ka omkhawm ding uh hi.
Kei hong it lo mi in ka thu a zui kei hi. Note zak thute in kei thu hi lo kei hong sawl Pa’ thu ahi hi.”
“Note tawh ka omkhawm lai takin hih thu kong hilh zo hi.
Ahih hangin ka min tawh Pa in hong sawl ding Huhpa a kici Kha Siangtho in na khempeuh hong hilh ding a, no kiangah kong gen khempeuh hong phawkkik sak ding hi.
Nopna note kong pia hi; keima nopna kong pia hi. Leitung mite in a piak bangin kong pia kei hi. Na lungmang kei un la, na lau kei un.

‘Ka ciah hangin no kiangah kong paikik ding hi,’ ka cihna thu na za uh hi. Nong it uh leh, Pa kiangah ciah ding ka hih ciangin na nuam ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kei sangin Pa a lianzaw hi.
Tua thu a tun’ ciangin na up nadingun, hong tun’ ma-in kong genkhol zo hi.
Tu-a kipanin note kiangah thu tampi kong gen nawn kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hih leitung ukpa hong pai a; ahih hangin kei tungah thu a nei kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in Pa’ hong thupiakna bangin ka hih a, Pa ka it cih leitung mite in a theihtheih nading ahi hi. Tho un, paikhia ni.”
